investigations.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
investigations.gravity_context: orbital microgravity; not per-test measured gravity
investigations.objective: Investigate liquid-droplet combustion and limiting oxygen conditions, including effects of ambient pressure and dilution.
investigations.platform: Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA) in the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), ISS

findings.title: Solid samples, geometry and flow
findings.summary: The hardware supports PMMA rods, slabs and spherical sections, plus flat blended fabric. Mounting can support opposed or concurrent flow; hot-wire ignition is described.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Apparatus description is not a verified mounting or ignition mapping for every PSI row.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Daily oxygen correction
findings.summary: CSA-CP oxygen readings use a daily MCA-referenced offset. The stated sensor resolution is distinct from per-value uncertainty.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text

quantities.qualifier: Sensor resolution, not an error bar.

limitations: No new correction applied to already-corrected PSI values.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Nitrogen dilution model
findings.summary: A continuously stirred tank model describes nitrogen dilution, with instantaneous mixing and constant pressure, temperature and volume assumptions.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Model assumptions must not become measured test conditions.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Oxygen-consumption calorimetry
findings.summary: Reported heat release estimates use oxygen consumption and burn duration with a specified heat-per-oxygen-mass factor.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text

quantities.raw: 13.1 kJ of heat released per gram of O2 consumed
quantities.qualifier: Report calculation factor, not a test heat-release measurement.

limitations: No individual heat-release values are imported.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Heat-release summary
findings.summary: Most reported tests had estimated heat release well below 100 W. The report also discusses window damage during one prolonged burn near that level.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text

quantities.raw: most of the tests released well below 100 W
quantities.qualifier: Reference level only; most, well below. Not an exact measurement.

limitations: This qualified aggregate is neither a per-test value nor a safe operating threshold.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Pressure exists for a report subset
findings.summary: The opposed-flow section reports monitored pressure spanning 99.2 to 99.5 kPa for its described tests. The imported PSI tables still have no pressure column.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Subset association to normalized CSV rows remains unresolved; do not backfill.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Gas-law inputs are assumptions
findings.summary: The oxygen-consumption gas-law calculation uses pressure of 1 atm and temperature of 300 K. These are calculation inputs, distinct from measured row conditions.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: No per-test pressure or temperature inferred.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Combustion products depend on configuration
findings.summary: CO versus CO2 follows a linear trend in some datasets, but not across all fuel geometries and flows described.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Do not generalize one relationship across geometries or infer toxicity limits.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Liquid-fuel droplet research
findings.summary: FLEX uses MDCA inside the CIR chamber on ISS. This report archives the first 284 tests; that historical count is not the number of imported FIRETRACE rows.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text

quantities.qualifier: Historical report count only, not imported records.

limitations: No FLEX tests are normalized here; 284 is report scope.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Fuels and atmosphere scope
findings.summary: The report covers methanol and n-heptane droplets in oxygen diluted with nitrogen, carbon dioxide or their mixtures, with reported pressure scope of 0.70 to 3.05 atm.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Report range does not supply conditions for any individual normalized row.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Free and supported droplets
findings.summary: Droplets may be free-floating or fiber-supported; translated fibers introduce prescribed subbuoyant flow. Support and motion must be checked before comparisons.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Not equivalent to solid-sample forced-flow flame spread.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Different extinction behaviors
findings.summary: Both radiative and diffusive extinction are reported, along with disruptive extinctions. This is a qualitative report observation, not a material safety classification.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Needle contamination qualifications in Section5.2 apply; no new row outcome labels.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Droplet imaging uncertainty
findings.summary: The HiBMs droplet-size analysis estimates uncertainty of plus or minus 50 micrometres after considering resolution, segmentation and image noise.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text

quantities.qualifier: Symmetric plus/minus method estimate; not per-test.

limitations: Method estimate only; not assigned as an uncertainty to each CSV measurement.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Radiometric output not reported
findings.summary: The radiometers were insufficiently sensitive for reliable quantitative output in the reported tests, so those data are not reported.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: An instrument being installed does not establish usable measurement coverage.

findings.title: A trace ending is not necessarily extinction
findings.summary: Droplet drift can end or interrupt camera histories. An abrupt trace end may mark loss from the field of view rather than the end of a test.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Do not infer extinction from truncated image traces.
Not mapped to individual normalized experiment records.

findings.title: Contamination qualifies observations
findings.summary: The authors consider some minor disruptions probably influenced by needle coating. Methanol disruptive extinction is probably contamination-related; heptane disruptive burning remains unresolved in this dataset.
findings.content_origin: FIRETRACE-authored paraphrase; not original NASA text
limitations: Preserve the authors' probable and unresolved qualifications; do not assert a universal causal result.
